facts.fact: IFC, with BIFT, is providing Complete Farmer, a Ghanaian agritech company whose platform connects farmers with buyers and financiers, a US$2.4 million convertible loan plus US$660,000 in advisory and grant support, announced by IFC on 16 September 2026; IFC is a multilateral development finance institution (World Bank Group).
facts.system: IFC convertible loan to Complete Farmer

note: Absa Bank Ghana US$50m unfunded risk participation (up to US$200m lending to cocoa Licensed Buying Companies) is not a digital business, so no fact.
